items.name: Château de la Bâtie d’Urfé
items.evidence: Miniature in summer2001 pict0051; paired arcaded gallery, pale facade, stair turret, detached garden rotunda. Named in secondary inventory; original monument architecture corroborated by LoireTourisme.

items.name: Château de Chalmazel
items.evidence: Miniature in summer2001 pict0052; high round towers around keep, low red-roofed outer range. Named in secondary inventory and architectural identity corroborated by LoireForez tourism.

items.name: Cathédrale de Clermont-Ferrand
items.evidence: Two summer2001 photographs pict0053/54 show distinctive paired Gothic spires and flying buttresses. Named in secondary inventory; single model, not two attractions.

items.name: Puits Couriot
items.evidence: Summer2001 pict0055 shows mine headframe, low industrial buildings and paired spoil heaps. Explicitly named in secondary inventory; exhibit not an actual mine ride.

items.name: Collégiale de Saint-Bonnet-le-Château
items.evidence: Summer2001 pict0057 shows church with two asymmetrical square towers, rose window and stepped entrance. Correct religious-building identity corroborated by LoireTourisme; do not import wiki mislabel Château de Saint-Bonnet-le-Château as another exhibit.
